name: Keyhole Wipe
description: A keyhole with a bevelled rim grows from a point until the second clip fills the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Center of the keyhole (0..1, y down)

params.name: rim
params.description: Strength of the bevelled rim and inner shadow (0: clean cut)
